recall.uz: Bahorda qaytadigan qushlar haqidagi hikoyani tinglab oʻqiymiz, voqealar tartibini topamiz va qush nomlarini yigʻamiz.
recall.ru: Слушаем рассказ о птицах, что возвращаются весной, находим порядок событий и собираем названия птиц.
recall.en: We read a story about the birds that return in spring, order the events, and build bird names.

props.title: Bahor elchilari
lines: — Oyijon, bular qanaqa qushlar? — soʻradi Malika.
— Bular turnalar, ular bizga bahorni olib kelishdi.
— Bahor juda yaxshi fasl ekan-da! — dedi Malika quvonib.

prompt.ru: Послушай и читай рассказ, следя за текстом!
prompt.en: Listen and follow along as you read the story!

explanation.uz: Hikoya bahorda qaytgan turnalar va ona-bola suhbati haqida.
explanation.ru: Рассказ о вернувшихся весной журавлях и разговоре мамы с дочкой.
explanation.en: The story is about cranes returning in spring and a mother-daughter chat.

text.en: Malika woke up to the birds' calls.
She looked out of the window.
Cranes were flying across the sky.
She asked her mother about the birds.
Mother explained that spring had come.

prompt.ru: Нажимай события в порядке, как они произошли!
prompt.en: Tap the events in the order they happened!

explanation.uz: Uygʻonish → derazaga qarash → turnalar → savol → onaning javobi.
explanation.ru: Проснулась → посмотрела в окно → журавли → вопрос → ответ мамы.
explanation.en: Woke up → looked out → cranes → question → mother's answer.

prompt.en: Build the bird's name from the syllables!

why.uz: Ona «ular bizga bahorni olib kelishdi» dedi.
why.ru: Мама сказала, что они принесли весну.
why.en: Mother said they brought spring to us.

prompt.en: According to the text, what is this statement?

hint.en: What did mother say about the cranes?

statement.ru: Брат Малики тоже подошёл к окну.
statement.en: Malika's brother also came to the window.

why.uz: Hikoyada aka haqida hech narsa aytilmagan.
why.ru: В рассказе о брате ничего не сказано.
why.en: The story says nothing about a brother.

prompt.en: According to the text, what is this statement?

before.en: Malika saw cranes flying in the sky.

text.uz: U onasidan «bular qanaqa qushlar?» deb soʻradi.
text.ru: Она спросила маму: «что это за птицы?»
text.en: She asked her mother, “what birds are those?”

prompt.en: What did Malika do after seeing the cranes?

explanation.en: Malika asked her mother about the birds.

prompt.en: Match each word to its meaning!

explanation.uz: qiygʻos = baravariga; turna = koʻchmanchi qush; elchi = darak keltiruvchi.
explanation.ru: qiygʻos = разом; turna = журавль; elchi = вестник.
explanation.en: qiygʻos = all at once; turna = crane; elchi = a herald.

choices.uz: Ularga in qurishga yordam berish, ozor bermaslik
choices.en: Help them and never harm them

prompt.en: How should we care for birds?

explanation.uz: Qushlarga gʻamxoʻrlik qilamiz, ozor bermaymiz — ular bizning doʻstlarimiz.
explanation.ru: Заботимся о птицах и не обижаем — они наши друзья.
explanation.en: We care for birds and never harm them — they are our friends.

openEnd.uz: Sen qushlarga qanday gʻamxoʻrlik qila olasan?
openEnd.ru: Как ты можешь позаботиться о птицах?
openEnd.en: How can you take care of birds?

prompt.en: Tap the birds that fly back in spring!

explanation.uz: Turna, qaldirgʻoch, laylak — qushlar; baliq va kapalak esa qush emas.
explanation.ru: Журавль, ласточка, аист — птицы; рыба и бабочка — нет.
explanation.en: Crane, swallow, stork are birds; a fish and a butterfly are not.

prompt.ru: Выбери слово и вставь в пропуск!
prompt.en: Pick a word and fill each gap!

hint.ru: Птицы летают и они наши друзья.
hint.en: Birds fly and they are our friends.

explanation.uz: «Qushlar — bizning qanotli doʻstlarimiz, ularga gʻamxoʻrlik qilaylik».
explanation.ru: «Птицы — наши крылатые друзья, давайте о них заботиться».
explanation.en: “Birds are our winged friends; let's take care of them.”
